frontDoorText: ◇ Recommendation · foundation missionVite + React + VitestYou said “website with charts” — React has the chart libraries, and you have used it before in two repos on this machine.Vitest runs your tests in about a second, so the red-then-green proof on every ticket stays fast instead of becoming the slow part.CSV import is a pure function — the easiest thing in your idea to write a real first test against.What this first mission buildsA running skeleton — it boots and shows something.A working test system for Vite + React + Vitest that you can watch run.One thin vertical slice that proves both: importing a CSV row and showing it.Budgets, charts, bank import — recorded in your vision, and each becomes a normal mission once the foundation lands.✓ Accept & file mission⇄ Choose a different stack
